name: folio
description: Folio — an AI terminal that grows a living tech book with you: chapters written on demand, select any line to ask or drill down.

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:renderer
scripts.test:core: node --test src/main/architecture-analyzer.test.js src/main/command-policy.test.js src/main/sandbox.test.js src/main/security-analyzer.test.js src/main/muse/learning-maps.test.js src/main/muse/react-engine.test.js src/main/task-engine/state.test.js src/main/task-engine/tools/command.test.js
scripts.check:syntax: find src/main src/preload src/shared src/mcp-server scripts -name '*.js' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec node --check {} +
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm test && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:renderer" "wait-on http://localhost:3009 && npm run dev:electron"
